material_findings.finding: A sustained multi-tick GRID10 run exposed a real coordinator lease-TTL failure that the short acceptance harness did not reach: after the original lease exceeded its TTL, later packets could remain uncommitted while the node kept polling. The committed fix revokes a lease after commit_error and permits re-election; a real sqlite-backed regression test was added and the operation report states pre-fix failure/post-fix pass plus a fresh 17/17 acceptance regression.
material_findings.reason: The run/report is materially stronger than model consensus, but the sustained execution is not bound to the current canonical control-transport/quiescence authority with clean HEAD/tree/source-hash/dirty=false runtime evidence.

material_findings.finding: Fresh fallback provenance and the GRID10 operation report explicitly record a real NVIDIA Nemotron free-pool call after canonical authority 9.13 already set all autonomous provider routes false under OWNER_EMERGENCY_STOP/HARD_OFF. The report says it fell back 'per standing instruction'; that standing instruction is stale non-authority under current FREE_ONLY/HARD_OFF.
material_findings.required_closure: The actual stern.py -> harness_aider.py -> external last-resort caller path must execute the canonical fail-closed provider gate before secret lookup/provider import/network/Aider fallback. Under 9.13 HARD_OFF the real caller must be repository/runtime receipted with provider_calls=0 and secret_lookups=0. A standalone gate file is insufficient.

material_findings.finding: The operation report states ten node processes were deliberately left alive with roughly 50 minutes of remaining polling capacity while runtime control transport/quiescence remained unresolved in the current supervisor. This is useful bounded diagnostic operation but cannot mint current Physical-GRID10/HCU runtime credit or supersede the quiescence/control-sync P0.

The research line was redirected away from calling the current driver/model combination a world model. This conclusion is acceptable as non-authority research prioritization because the executable sustained-run evidence shows the driver, not the small model, computes the key collapse/preserve rule. Nemotron agreement adds no independence or canonical-semantics credit and must not be counted under Goodman anti-echo.

next_focus: P0_CLOSE_REAL_FREEPOOL_CALLER_BOUNDARY: bind the executable stern.py/harness_aider.py/last-resort path to current canonical provider admission before any secret lookup/import/network/fallback; under HARD_OFF require provider_calls=0 and secret_lookups=0.

P0_RESUME_EXISTING_CONTROL_TRANSPORT_FRONTIER: repository-bound bootstrap-v2/refresh tests, owning-VPS clean/current authority binding, then restart-authority-v4 read-only and at least 90 seconds zero survivors/descendants/restarts before runtime promotion.

P1_KEEP_GRID10_LEASE_FIX: run the new lease-renewal regression repository-bound on a clean current non-provider checkout and bind HEAD/tree/source hashes/stdout/stderr; then include sustained >TTL behavior in future GRID10 acceptance so one-shot 17/17 cannot mask lease expiry.
P1_DO_NOT_USE_NEMOTRON_CONSENSUS_AS_GOODMAN_INDEPENDENCE: provider/model critique may motivate tests but cannot promote canonical semantics, BASE, model selection or HCU claims.
P2_ONLY_AFTER_CONTROL_AND_QUIESCENCE_CLOSURE: execute concrete GRID10 application workloads with repository-bound receipts and explicit component-only credit boundaries.
